title: Calibration set
desc: Print a temperature tower and a calibration cube, measure them, and write down the settings that work for each filament.

title: Gridfinity drawer bins
desc: Print a baseplate and a few bins to organise one drawer. The grid is 42 mm, so bins from different designers fit together.

title: Custom cable clips
desc: Measure a cable, model a clip to fit it, and print it. A small part is the quickest way to learn tolerances.

title: Print-in-place hinge box
desc: Design a small box whose hinge prints already assembled. You will learn clearances and bridging.

title: Heat-set insert enclosure
desc: Make an electronics case with threaded brass inserts so the lid can be screwed on and off many times.

title: Headphone hook
desc: Design a hook that clamps under your desk. A good first part to measure, model and print yourself.

title: Adjustable phone stand
desc: A stand with two or three viewing angles and a slot for the charging cable.

title: Vase-mode plant pot
desc: Print a pot as one continuous spiral wall, plus a matching drip tray in normal mode.

title: Lithophane night light
desc: Turn a favourite photo into a curved lithophane and mount it over a small light.

title: Threaded jar and lid
desc: Model a screw-top jar and adjust the clearance until the lid turns smoothly.

title: Cookie cutter from a drawing
desc: Trace a simple drawing into an outline and extrude it into a cutter. Wash by hand only.

title: Spool-core drawers
desc: Fit curved swing-out drawers into an empty spool to hold screws and nozzles.

title: Print-in-place gears
desc: A set of gears that prints already assembled and turns straight off the bed.

title: Replacement knob
desc: Measure a broken or missing knob at home and print a replacement that fits the shaft.

title: Pegboard tool holders
desc: Design holders for your own tools that hook into a pegboard, each sized to one tool.

title: Tolerance test coin
desc: A small disc with slots from 0.1 to 0.5 mm that shows what clearance your printer can manage.

title: Two-colour name tags
desc: Change filament part-way up the print to get raised lettering in a second colour.

title: Under-desk cable tray
desc: A tray in sections that screws under a desk and hides a power strip and its cables.

title: Board game token set
desc: Replace cardboard tokens from a favourite game with printed ones, and a tray to hold them.

title: Living-hinge bag clip
desc: A clip that folds on a thin printed hinge. Test how many bends it survives.
